+"""Directed pair projection with a soft-gradient nearest-code assignment."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Compute the proposal's masked directed projection/separation penalty."""
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.2)
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    margin = parameters.get("margin", 0.1)
+    min_separation = parameters.get("min_separation", 0.1)
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.0001)
+
+    mask = mask.to(device=source.device, dtype=source.dtype).reshape(-1)
+    if not bool(torch.any(mask > 0).item()):
+        return (source.sum() + target.sum() + codebook.sum()) * 0.0
+
+    # Soft assignments carry gradients across codes. The straight-through form
+    # keeps the declared nearest-code endpoints as the forward-pass values.
+    source_logits = -torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau
+    target_logits = -torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau
+    p_s = torch.softmax(source_logits, dim=-1)
+    p_t = torch.softmax(target_logits, dim=-1)
+    hard_s = F.one_hot(source_logits.argmax(dim=-1), codebook.shape[0]).to(source.dtype)
+    hard_t = F.one_hot(target_logits.argmax(dim=-1), codebook.shape[0]).to(source.dtype)
+    c_s_soft, c_t_soft = p_s @ codebook, p_t @ codebook
+    c_s = hard_s @ codebook + c_s_soft - c_s_soft.detach()
+    c_t = hard_t @ codebook + c_t_soft - c_t_soft.detach()
+
+    d = c_t - c_s
+    distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(d, dim=-1)
+    projection = ((target - source) * d).sum(dim=-1) / (d.square().sum(dim=-1) + eps)
+    separation = F.relu(min_separation - distance)
+    per_pair = F.relu(margin - projection) * (1.0 + separation / (distance + eps))
